text: oh sorry to interrupt you but also this system should extend to the models i do make by hand in t he studio, maybe not something you need to capture now, maybe it is. just so that everything is uniform
resolution: Amendment to req_2141: make the attribution system uniform so it ALSO covers hand-made Studio models, and (the 'extend' signal) build it modular up front instead of god-filing the viewer cart. Done: all attribution logic + UI lives in the shared runtime/attribution/ module (ledger/credits/panel), not in cart/modelview. The ledger is origin-agnostic — keyed by content sha for imports OR model id for Studio models — and ships recordStudioModel() + a 'Self-made' license + an 'Original assets' section in CREDITS.md, so the Studio plugs into the SAME ledger/panel/export with one call. Studio wiring itself (calling recordStudioModel when a hand-made model is created) is the ready follow-on the user said could come later. Delivered together with req_2141 on 760ab3986.
